Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal

On The 5 th Of December, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 53253 of 2025
 Rahul Maurya
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Rajesh Kumar Patel - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Anuj Agarwal - Advocate for the Objector.

Shri B.K. Upadhyay - Govt. Advocate for the responden
 Order

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No. 392/2025 registered at Police Station - Ayodhya Nagar, District Bhopal (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 64, 351(2), 115(2) of BNS, 2023.

entities.text: Police Station - Ayodhya Nagar, District Bhopal
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant has been arrested on 10.09.2025.

2. As per the prosecution story, it is alleged that on 19.08.2025 applicant came to the house of prosecutrix and committed rape upon her and on protest, threatened to kill therefore, aforesaid offence has been registered against the applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
He is in custody since 10.09.2025.

It is further submitted that on earlier occasion also prosecutrix NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:63610 2 MCRC-53253-2025 has lodged report against the applicant and on the basis of compromise between both the parties, an order of acquittal for the offence u/s 376, 376(2) (N) of IPC, 66 (E) of I.T. Act has been passed by IIIrd Additional Sessions Judge, Sehore vide order dated 18.03.2025.
Later on present FIR is lodged against the applicant on the false grounds.
Charge sheet has been filed and conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the Objector as well as State have opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and submitted that earlier also prosecutrix has lodged the FIR against him regarding rape on the false pretext of marriage but due to settlement between the parties, an order Rahul Maurya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79102817/
1 of acquittal has been passed.

entities.text: Rahul Maurya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that when prosecutrix has married with other person in Delhi thereafter, present applicant used to call on mobile of husband of prosecutrix from different numbers and threatened him due to which husband of prosecutrix has filed a divorce petition and life of prosecutrix has been spoiled.
Hence, bail application be dismissed.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:63610 3 MCRC-53253-2025 he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
7. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
8. Certified copy as per rules.
